twice 0.1.0 usage:

twice genkey [keyfile]	# Generate encryption key (default: vpn.key)

twice	"server"
	<vpn server ip or name>|"auto"
	<vpn server port>|"auto"
	<tun interface>|"auto"
	<local tun ip>|"auto"
	<remote tun ip>"auto"
	<external ip>|"auto"

twice	"client"
	<vpn server ip or name>
	<vpn server port>|"auto"
	<tun interface>|"auto"
	<local tun ip>|"auto"
	<remote tun ip>|"auto"
	<gateway ip>|"auto"

Options:
	-k, --key <file>	Path to 256-bit key file for encryption
	-m, --mtu <mtu>		Set TUN interface MTU (default: 1420)
	-d, --discover-mtu	Automatically discover optimal MTU (client only)

Example:

[server]
	sudo ./twice server auto	# listen on UDP port 41194
	sudo ./twice -k vpn.key server auto	# with encryption
	sudo ./twice -m 1380 server auto	# with custom MTU

[client]
	sudo ./twice client 34.216.127.34
	sudo ./twice -k vpn.key client 34.216.127.34	# with encryption
	sudo ./twice -d client 34.216.127.34	# with MTU discovery
	sudo ./twice --mtu 1380 client 34.216.127.34

Generate encryption key:
	./twice genkey		# creates vpn.key
	./twice genkey mykey.key	# creates mykey.key
